4.9 stars. 150 reviews. Inside a Venice-themed town in Phu Quoc.

Cafe Juliet & Pastries sits inside Sunset Town and the rating makes sense the second you walk in. Coffee done right, pastries worth the detour, and an aesthetic that hits harder in person than in photos.

Budget $15-30 per person. Absolutely worth it.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
